title.zh: 翻译文档且不破坏排版

prompt.en:
Translate the full content of the uploaded business documents ==from English into Japanese and German==.
1. ==Preserve the original formatting exactly==, like layout, headings, fonts, styles, spacing, and alignment, etc.
2. ==Keep business and technical terminology consistent== throughout the documents. The translated files should be presentation-ready for my clients.
prompt.zh:
把上传的这些业务文档全文==翻译成日语和德语==。
1. ==完全保持原始格式==，包括排版、标题层级、字体、样式、间距、对齐方式等。
2. ==全篇业务和技术术语保持一致==。翻译后的文件要能直接用于客户展示。

reply.en: Translated all three documents into Japanese and German, keeping layout, headings, fonts, and terminology consistent throughout — ready to present to clients. Click the links below to view the translated files.
reply.zh: 已将三份文档分别翻译成日语和德语，排版、标题层级、字体和术语全篇保持一致，可以直接用于客户展示。点击下方链接查看翻译后的文件。

caption.zh: 翻译后的 Word 文档（日语）
